answers.ask: Long as in a tall tower you spiral up, or long as in a flat course that just keeps going?
answers.answer: Make it a very long flat course that keeps going, with tiger-themed sections along the way.

answers.ask: 'And more' beyond wallhops - moving platforms, disappearing platforms, tightropes, conveyors?
answers.answer: Include moving platforms, disappearing platforms, tightropes, and conveyors alongside wallhops so it is not only simple jumps.

scene_prompt: Create a very long, flat 3D obby course that extends forward through successive tiger-themed sections. Arrange a continuous route of platforming areas along the course, including wall-hop passages, moving and disappearing platforms, narrow tightropes, and conveyor sections, with tiger-themed scenery and props framing the path.
agent_notes: An obby, with the shape answer choosing a very long flat course that keeps going, so course-flat and the Classic Obby preset, and P6 as always for this genre. The second answer names the obstacle mix outright, so I added the rows it maps to on top of the preset: obstacle-climb for the wallhops and tightropes, obstacle-timing for disappearing platforms, obstacle-moving for moving platforms and conveyors, with obstacle-jump kept because 'don't just make it jumps' asks for more than jumps rather than none. Wallhops are a glitch-obby technique that the P6 generator cannot validate — they exploit undocumented Humanoid state timing rather than the documented jump limits — so the critical path should stay inside the standard 11-stud and 7.2-stud spacing and the wallhop sections be treated as author-supplied. Nothing said where the course ends, so I assumed a finish at the far end, which is what winner-zone places; tiger theming is dressing on the same course.
